## Usage notes

# Logos

Three wordmark directions and their favicon marks, outlined from Inter so they need no font. All single ink: `ink` `#0F172A`. For a reversed use, inline the SVG and set its fill to `action-ink` `#FFFFFF` on `ink`.

- `karma-a-wordmark.svg` — Direction A, Label: KARMA, Inter Bold, tracked 0.18em. The drop-in for the event.
- `karma-a-mark.svg` — Direction A mark: a K cut out of an ink square. Favicon.
- `karma-b-wordmark.svg` — Direction B, Citation: [karma], Inter SemiBold inside lighter square brackets.
- `karma-b-mark.svg` — Direction B mark: [k]. Favicon.
- `karma-c-wordmark.svg` — Direction C, Pulled line: the page mark and "Karma" in Inter SemiBold.
- `karma-c-mark.svg` — Direction C mark: a page with one line pulled out past its edge. Favicon.
- `karma-c-mark-two-colour.svg` — the same mark with the pulled line in `accent` `#2563EB`, for title slides and the favicon only.

Clear space: the wordmark's cap height on every side. Minimum: 12px cap height for wordmarks, 16px for marks.
